blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A 63-year-old American tourist died after he was allegedly hit with a chair during a fistfight at a bar in Panglao, Bohol, late Saturday, Sept. 27, police said. The victim, identified by the alias “Williams,” was reportedly staying at a resort in Barangay Tawala, Panglao. Initial investigation showed the incident happened at Escape Bar along Alona Beach.
